algorithm.Title: Postpartum - Leg Swelling and Edema - Female (Child)
algorithm.ContentSet: IST Open-Source Guideline Content | Child | Female
Definition: Postpartum leg swelling assessment, generalized from the same NHS.UK C-section recovery blood-clot warning sign as Postpartum - Leg Pain.
FirstAid: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 now. Keep the patient at rest and do not let them drive. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.

questions.Question: Is a high blood-pressure reading with headache or vision change the primary concern?
questions.Information: Postpartum high blood pressure with headache or vision change remains a direct Qatar 999 emergency and must not redirect to an adult-only general blood-pressure protocol.

questions.Question: Is one leg more swollen or painful than the other, along with shortness of breath or chest pain?
questions.Information: One-sided leg swelling with breathing/chest symptoms is a recognized blood clot red flag, and the postpartum period carries an elevated clotting risk regardless of delivery method.

questions.Question: Is one leg noticeably more swollen than the other, without breathing or chest symptoms?
questions.Information: Asymmetric leg swelling should be checked promptly to rule out a blood clot, given the elevated postpartum risk.

questions.Question: Is this mild, even swelling in both legs/ankles with none of the features above?
questions.Information: Mild, symmetric ankle/leg swelling is common after birth from fluid shifts and is usually not a clot concern.

advice.Title: Emergency postpartum blood clot precautions
Content: Call Qatar emergency services on 999 now. Keep the patient at rest and do not let them drive. Call Qatar 999 now, follow the call-taker's ambulance and emergency-transport instructions, and do not self-drive. Do not delay emergency care.
Call Back If: worsening breathing difficulty; chest pain develops.

advice.Title: Urgent postpartum leg swelling review
Content: Arrange prompt in-person assessment to rule out a blood clot; the exact non-emergency Qatar destination remains GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED.
Call Back If: breathing difficulty or chest pain develops; swelling worsens.

advice.Title: Home care for mild postpartum leg swelling
Content: Elevate the legs when resting, stay mobile with gentle walking, and drink plenty of fluids.
Call Back If: one leg becomes more swollen than the other; breathing difficulty develops.

references: NHS.UK, "Caesarean section - Recovery" (blood clot warning sign), https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/caesarean-section/recovery/ (page last reviewed 04 January 2023) - generalized to all postpartum deliveries
